title: Canonical scalar unit and shift normalization for exceptional realization
statement: For a prime ell, a field k of positive prime characteristic different from ell, and the canonical lifted E=Q_ell and realization U of [def-pur-exceptional-reconstruction-presentations], fix the supplied realization data D [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization]. On every separated finite-type k-scheme T, define the ambient scalar model as derived extension along the completed-to-rational coefficient inclusion, the inverse exact section-module encoding, and derived extension to the fixed algebraic closure [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization]. Its right adjoint is restriction through the same maps, with their original composite adjunction. Define its comparison with U using the recorded scalarExtension isomorphism and the section-encoding unit. Define ordinary restriction, its canonical derived-composition comparison and the regular completed coefficient module. IsCoefficientInclusion requires that an ordinary map from this regular module into restricted closure coefficients equals the composite coefficient inclusion on every section. Derive this map using single-in-degree-zero and its canonical exact-functor comparison. Equip the ambient scalar model with the canonical CommShift: the scalar-adjunction shift on derived extension, the exact derived shift on the inverse encoding, and the exact-derived shift transported to closure extension. These constructions specify the tensor-multiplication unit and the shift comparisons used by reconstruction.
